title: Yellow Fluffy Malaysian Vegetable Bake
description: A peppery and fluffy Malaysian dish featuring mustard powder, perfect for a hangover cure, this plant-based friendly bake is a delicious and comforting meal. It combines the flavors of Malaysia with the simplicity of a vegetable bake.

ingredients.name: mustard powder
ingredients.notes: use a high quality powder for best flavor

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mustard powder, turmeric, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the mixed vegetables and cubed tofu to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir until the mixture is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and the vegetables are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
